pr_comments: There are no existing docs for the TS_RESP_CTX related functions.. I have added a minimal set for the new.

24 hours has passed since 'approval: done' was set, but as this PR has been updated in that time the label 'approval: ready to merge' is not being automatically set.  Please review the updates and set the label manually.
Addressed NITS (in last fixup commit) and rebased..
Rebased to fix generated file. No changes were made.
@slontis, do you remember what was outstanding here?  The commit says it is a partial fix.

There are still some calls to EVP_Digest() and EVP_DigestInit_ex()
If you do a search for EVP_sha1()
EVP_PKEY_CTX_set_dh_kdf_md() also

Note that X509_digest() is fine since it uses the libctx from the cert.

issue_context.title: Replace the EVP_sha1() and similar calls with explicit algorithm fetch
issue_context.body: At least in places where we have a libctx available we should never use EVP_sha1() and others but instead fetch the algorithm explicitly.
comments: We should, however, ensure that we still have tests that use older calls...
Yes, sure. I filled this mostly for the libcrypto changes needed.
NOTE - X509_digest is fine as it is.. it does a fetch internally since X509 known the libctx, propq.

NOTE: I did a bit of a look around for const ciphers and  digests..

The ones that need more work are SHA1, SHA256, MD5
(RC4 is used also)

review_comments: Does this need to be up_ref'ed?
That would be hard to do since a libctx doesn't have a ref count :-)
libctx is used like this everywhere..

Is it worthwhile considering this as a `const char *` ?
Yeah, I know it means a cast on free which is why I'm not too fussed.
This is like this in every other struct - so if you wanted to do that it should be another PR.. I don't think it is necessary.
Shouldn't EVP_MD_is_a() check if the passed method is NULL, and always return false in that case?
This is not a blocker, it can be dealt with in another PR
